changes: Bootstrap checks optional Copilot only when its binary is on PATH. Installed-but-broken still fails; standalone doctor always remains strict.

Settings temporary file is fsynced before rename; parent directory is synced afterward. Unsupported directory sync EINVAL/ENOTSUP/EISDIR is tolerated; real errors, including EIO and EPERM, propagate. File sync failures preserve prior settings; post-rename failure reports applied changes; descriptors and temporary files are cleaned up.
Copilot returns changed/skipped counts, consumed by all repository callers. Copilot-only link/settings mutation no longer prints everything already linked.

Native config.json trust is scoped to the new canonical temporary workspace. The full-driver trust discriminator rejects reused HOME, wrong/missing native config, negative-control provider activity, and non-exact prompt paths.
The earlier same-HOME settings.json seed attribution is explicitly retracted in install-startup-trust.json.

tests.durability_cases: Real isolated file/directory sync ordering, enabled no-write, closed descriptors, file EIO/EINVAL preserving old bytes, directory EIO/EPERM failing after rename, unsupported directory EINVAL/ENOTSUP succeeding, no leaked temporary files.
